# Lattice

Lattice is deterministic multi-agent benchmarking with auditable replay: a headless .NET 10 environment for seeded Dec-POMDP-style experiments where every run is a replayable recording.

- CLI reference: docs/CLI.md

- Benchmarking: docs/BENCHMARKING.md
- Ecosystem: docs/ECOSYSTEM.md
